assessments.reasoning: The pinned Index taxonomy includes historical editions and identifiable grants for code and documentation. W3C’s operative permission to use, copy, modify and distribute satisfies the license criterion despite the word “Notice” in the title.

The w3.org Consortium/Legal archive returned copyright-software-19980720.html at the scoped full digest. Bytes [472,528) identify the Software Notice and License. The grant and the chronology surrounding bytes [3444,3475) identify the formulation and its activation. The 1994–2002 copyright line and 2002 update describe the archived witness without establishing first publication.

The pinned Index decision, bytes [6184,6400), binds ddc57fcabba446b9b1265888c49c7c03, W3C Software Notice and License (1998 edition), w3c-1998, sha256:d4eedcb04dc16687b6d56b49ed06e1b55f599b8bd8e518af9773d1b7d2cf5c76, license and active. W3C-19980720 appears in the separate SPDX identifier column.

challenge.method: Tested July 20, 1998 from the filename and SPDX identifier as a possible publication date, and February 13, 2002 from the footer as a possible edition date. Compared the linked older formulation and the separate 2002 Index row with the target.
challenge.results: The archive labels August 14 as activation and February 13 as a last update. Neither those labels nor the filename establishes first online publication. The older-formulation link describes prior policy. The 2002 decision row has a different entity and digest. The 1998 row expressly says active.

limitations: August 14, 1998 is the publisher’s stated activation date. The first online publication date remains unknown from this witness.

The publisher’s historical use of “active” and the Index’s 2026 editorial use describe separate events. The Index decision establishes no publisher currency, SPDX deprecation status or consumer release authorization.

The grant carries notice conditions. Applicability to a project, redistribution of the text and installation eligibility require separate evidence. The archive’s GPL discussion supplies historical context.
reasoning: W3C’s archive presents a conditional software and documentation license and says this formulation became active on August 14, 1998. The Index taxonomy admits the grant. The separately pinned Index decision assigns active to the 1998 entity at the exact archive digest.
